messages:
alice: heads-up — mkdocs build failing on staging after the i18n migration, looks like a bunch of broken fragment jumps. saw a 404 for `#how-it-works` on /guides/deploy
ben: can you paste the failing link and the page that references it? quick repro helps. :mag:
alice: sure — page: /docs/guides/deploy.md -> link to /docs/architecture/#how-it-works
alice: build log snippet:
```
WARNING - 404: /docs/architecture/#how-it-works
WARNING - The page 'guides/deploy.md' contains a broken reference to 'architecture/#how-it-works'
```
carla: hm, after the slugify changes some headings lost their ascii-folding. `How it Works` became `how‑it‑works` (with a non-breaking hyphen) in the generated anchor. mkdocs and docusaurus slugifiers differ.
carla: quick check: run `mkdocs serve` and inspect the generated html id on the architecture page.
ben: ok — if the generated id has a NBSP or weird punctuation we should normalize during the link rewrite step in the migration script.
derek: I can push a tiny PR that normalizes heading slugs (replace unicode hyphens & NBSPs with ASCII `-`) and add a unit test for slugify edgecases. want me to go ahead? @alice
alice: please do. also add a note to the migration guide about re-running `python scripts/regenerate-links.py` after editing headings. i'm seeing a few other links fail similarly.
derek: will open PR in a minute. patch will be small:
```
def normalize_slug(s):
    return re.sub(r"[\u00A0\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013]+", "-", s).lower()
```
docs-bot: CI check failed for branch fix/slug-normalize — mkdocs build error persists on one locale: de. See: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234
ben: looks like one locale has a localized heading that ends with a colon — slugifier drops trailing punctuation differently. add a test for localized strings.
carla: also add a small migration helper that prints out orphaned links: `scripts/find-orphans.py` — that made triage faster for me earlier.
derek: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/432 — includes normalize_slug + tests + short changelog note. Didn't touch generated html in /site/ yet.
alice: will run the prod linkcheck once PR is merged.
derek: CI green now on my branch, added test cases for NBSP + en-dash + German trailing colon. request review from @carla and @ben.
carla: code looks good, left 2 tiny comments about regex escaping. once addressed, merge.
ben: approved. merging after tests finish. :shipit:
docs-bot: PR merged by ben. Build kicked: nightly-site-deploy job #789 started.
alice: thanks all — leaving a follow-up TODO to scan docs for similar unicode punctuation issues and add a short paragraph to the migration guide about running the link regenerator. :memo:
ben: noted, created ticket DOCS-215 to track cleanup sweep.
carla: nice. that should reduce noisy CI failures in the short term. :+1:
}
